thesis: This episode argues that Fiat was the only correct buyer for Ferrari, acquiring 50% immediately and planning to take a 90% stake upon Enzo's death. It also notes that Ford thought Ferrari was worth between $10 and $18 million earlier in the decade, but Enzo had only one bidder. Additionally, it mentions that Lamborghini was founded in 1963 specifically to challenge Ferrari, launching the excellent Miura which was a better Ferrari than a Ferrari at the time.
